item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day is full, and busy days are when water gets forgotten. Start with a full glass before your morning routine, then keep a bottle within reach all day. Sip steadily instead of chugging at night. Pair a drink with things you already do, like a walk, a swim, or a meal. Staying hydrated steadies your mood and energy. Action: drink a full glass of water right now.
